Definition: a Machavite or inhabitant of some place named Machaveh
BiblicalUsage: Eliel the Mahavite is named once, in 1 Chronicles 11:46, in the roll of David's mighty men.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a single-line name in David's army still counts: loyalty that shows up gets written down.
